Status: Saved 103.gif shows a moving bear crawl, not the instructed stationary hover hold
Exact instructions:
1. Start on your hands and knees with toes tucked under.
2. Keep your back flat and core braced.
3. Lift your knees one to two inches off the floor.
4. Hold the hover position while breathing normally.

Status: Saved 124.gif omits the complete 12/3/6 clock sequence and required leg switch
Exact instructions:
1. Stand on one leg imagining you are in the center of a clock.
2. Tap your free foot lightly toward 12 o'clock, 3 o'clock, and 6 o'clock.
3. Keep your supporting knee steady and torso upright.
4. Switch legs and repeat in the opposite direction.
